name: National Economics Challenge
what_you_do: Take a test on small and large economics and the world economy. Compete for cash prizes. There are two groups: Adam Smith (AP, honors and returning players) and David Ricardo (first-time players).
who_can_apply: High school students on a team of 3 to 4 with a coach. David Ricardo is for first-year economics students. Adam Smith is for AP, IB and honors students and past players.
pay_detail: No pay. Cash prizes. Cost to enter is not stated.
deadline_text: As of Nov 9, 2026: team building runs Nov 2 to Mar 15, 2027. The qualifier exam runs Jan 2 to Mar 15, 2027. State rounds run Mar 15 to May 1. National Finals are June 9 to 10, 2027 in Philadelphia.
how_to_apply: Make a team on the challenge site and add a coach. Pick a division, then take the qualifier exam. Ask an economics teacher to be your coach.
notes: The old page link now sends readers to a new challenge site. That site also says early access in some states opens in November 2026. Entry cost is not posted. Confirm first.
